It applies to every claim submitted through the service claim system.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 1. Interpretation\\r\\n\\r\\n### 1.4  Precedence between instruments\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere two or more instruments address the same asset, the order of precedence is: (a) a Technical Service Bulletin that names the serial range of the asset; (b) the Regional Addendum for the region in which the asset is installed; (c) this policy. A Bulletin that has been superseded has no effect, whether or not it remains published. Where the Bulletin document and the service system applicability index disagree, the Bulletin document governs; the index is maintained for reporting and is informational only.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 2. Coverage\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.1  Standard coverage period\\r\\n  \\r\\nUnless extended or varied by an instrument of higher precedence, an asset is covered for twenty-four (24) months from the date of commissioning, or six thousand (6,000) running hours, whichever occurs first.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.3  Assets with no commissioning record\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere the commissioning record for an asset is absent from the asset registry, coverage cannot be determined. The claim is to be held and the commissioning certificate requested from the installing partner. The date of despatch or the date of installation must not be substituted for the date of commissioning.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. Amounts payable\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.1  Labour\\r\\n  \\r\\nLabour is payable at the flat-rate allowance published for the operation code in the current Flat Rate Labour schedule, or at the hours actually claimed, whichever is the lesser. The rate applied is the regional labour rate in force on the date of repair.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.2  Parts\\r\\n  \\r\\nParts are payable at the published list price for the region, for the part actually fitted. Where a part has been superseded, the price of the superseding part applies.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.3  Handling\\r\\n  \\r\\nA handling uplift on parts is payable only where the partner\\u0027s Service Partner Agreement expressly grants one, at the percentage stated in that agreement.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 5. Exclusions\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.1  Exclusion - misuse and overload\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from operation outside the published duty envelope, including sustained overload, is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.2  Exclusion - fluid contamination\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from hydraulic fluid contamination above ISO 4406 class 18/16/13 is excluded, save where a Technical Service Bulletin provides otherwise.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.3  Exclusion - unauthorised modification\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from modification not authorised in writing by Contoso Industrial is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.4  Exclusion - consumables\\r\\n  \\r\\nFilters, fluids, belts, seals and other consumables are excluded when replaced as scheduled maintenance. Scheduled maintenance is not claimable under warranty and has no warranty operation code, so a consumable claimed under a warranty repair operation code is treated as a corrective repair and is covered, unless an inspection report records the replacement as routine.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 6. Repair warranty\\r\\n\\r\\n### 6.1  Repair warranty\\r\\n  \\r\\nA component replaced under warranty carries a further ninety (90) days of coverage from the date the repair was completed. A claim arising within that period is adjudicated under this clause and carries funding code RW, whether or not the underlying asset remains within its coverage period.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 7. Goodwill and authority\\r\\n\\r\\n### 7.1  Goodwill authority\\r\\n  \\r\\nAn amount payable outside coverage may be authorised as goodwill only by a person holding the tier of authority set out in the Goodwill and Authority Matrix for that amount, and only where the authority is recorded in the claim system. An approval given in conversation, in a channel message, or by telephone does not constitute authority for the purposes of this clause.\u0022,\u0022RelevanceScore\u0022:0.68889165}]}]}"}]

It applies to every claim submitted through the service claim system.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 1. Interpretation\\r\\n\\r\\n### 1.4  Precedence between instruments\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere two or more instruments address the same asset, the order of precedence is: (a) a Technical Service Bulletin that names the serial range of the asset; (b) the Regional Addendum for the region in which the asset is installed; (c) this policy. A Bulletin that has been superseded has no effect, whether or not it remains published. Where the Bulletin document and the service system applicability index disagree, the Bulletin document governs; the index is maintained for reporting and is informational only.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 2. Coverage\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.1  Standard coverage period\\r\\n  \\r\\nUnless extended or varied by an instrument of higher precedence, an asset is covered for twenty-four (24) months from the date of commissioning, or six thousand (6,000) running hours, whichever occurs first.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.3  Assets with no commissioning record\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere the commissioning record for an asset is absent from the asset registry, coverage cannot be determined. The claim is to be held and the commissioning certificate requested from the installing partner. The date of despatch or the date of installation must not be substituted for the date of commissioning.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. Amounts payable\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.1  Labour\\r\\n  \\r\\nLabour is payable at the flat-rate allowance published for the operation code in the current Flat Rate Labour schedule, or at the hours actually claimed, whichever is the lesser. The rate applied is the regional labour rate in force on the date of repair.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.2  Parts\\r\\n  \\r\\nParts are payable at the published list price for the region, for the part actually fitted. Where a part has been superseded, the price of the superseding part applies.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.3  Handling\\r\\n  \\r\\nA handling uplift on parts is payable only where the partner\\u0027s Service Partner Agreement expressly grants one, at the percentage stated in that agreement.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 5. Exclusions\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.1  Exclusion - misuse and overload\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from operation outside the published duty envelope, including sustained overload, is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.2  Exclusion - fluid contamination\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from hydraulic fluid contamination above ISO 4406 class 18/16/13 is excluded, save where a Technical Service Bulletin provides otherwise.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.3  Exclusion - unauthorised modification\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from modification not authorised in writing by Contoso Industrial is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.4  Exclusion - consumables\\r\\n  \\r\\nFilters, fluids, belts, seals and other consumables are excluded when replaced as scheduled maintenance. Scheduled maintenance is not claimable under warranty and has no warranty operation code, so a consumable claimed under a warranty repair operation code is treated as a corrective repair and is covered, unless an inspection report records the replacement as routine.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 6. Repair warranty\\r\\n\\r\\n### 6.1  Repair warranty\\r\\n  \\r\\nA component replaced under warranty carries a further ninety (90) days of coverage from the date the repair was completed. A claim arising within that period is adjudicated under this clause and carries funding code RW, whether or not the underlying asset remains within its coverage period.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 7. Goodwill and authority\\r\\n\\r\\n### 7.1  Goodwill authority\\r\\n  \\r\\nAn amount payable outside coverage may be authorised as goodwill only by a person holding the tier of authority set out in the Goodwill and Authority Matrix for that amount, and only where the authority is recorded in the claim system. It applies to every claim submitted through the service claim system.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 1. Interpretation\\r\\n\\r\\n### 1.4  Precedence between instruments\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere two or more instruments address the same asset, the order of precedence is: (a) a Technical Service Bulletin that names the serial range of the asset; (b) the Regional Addendum for the region in which the asset is installed; (c) this policy. A Bulletin that has been superseded has no effect, whether or not it remains published. Where the Bulletin document and the service system applicability index disagree, the Bulletin document governs; the index is maintained for reporting and is informational only.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 2. Coverage\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.1  Standard coverage period\\r\\n  \\r\\nUnless extended or varied by an instrument of higher precedence, an asset is covered for twenty-four (24) months from the date of commissioning, or six thousand (6,000) running hours, whichever occurs first.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.3  Assets with no commissioning record\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere the commissioning record for an asset is absent from the asset registry, coverage cannot be determined. The claim is to be held and the commissioning certificate requested from the installing partner. The date of despatch or the date of installation must not be substituted for the date of commissioning.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. Amounts payable\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.1  Labour\\r\\n  \\r\\nLabour is payable at the flat-rate allowance published for the operation code in the current Flat Rate Labour schedule, or at the hours actually claimed, whichever is the lesser. The rate applied is the regional labour rate in force on the date of repair.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.2  Parts\\r\\n  \\r\\nParts are payable at the published list price for the region, for the part actually fitted. Where a part has been superseded, the price of the superseding part applies.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.3  Handling\\r\\n  \\r\\nA handling uplift on parts is payable only where the partner\\u0027s Service Partner Agreement expressly grants one, at the percentage stated in that agreement.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 5. Exclusions\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.1  Exclusion - misuse and overload\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from operation outside the published duty envelope, including sustained overload, is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.2  Exclusion - fluid contamination\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from hydraulic fluid contamination above ISO 4406 class 18/16/13 is excluded, save where a Technical Service Bulletin provides otherwise.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.3  Exclusion - unauthorised modification\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from modification not authorised in writing by Contoso Industrial is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.4  Exclusion - consumables\\r\\n  \\r\\nFilters, fluids, belts, seals and other consumables are excluded when replaced as scheduled maintenance. Scheduled maintenance is not claimable under warranty and has no warranty operation code, so a consumable claimed under a warranty repair operation code is treated as a corrective repair and is covered, unless an inspection report records the replacement as routine.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 6. Repair warranty\\r\\n\\r\\n### 6.1  Repair warranty\\r\\n  \\r\\nA component replaced under warranty carries a further ninety (90) days of coverage from the date the repair was completed. A claim arising within that period is adjudicated under this clause and carries funding code RW, whether or not the underlying asset remains within its coverage period.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 7. Goodwill and authority\\r\\n\\r\\n### 7.1  Goodwill authority\\r\\n  \\r\\nAn amount payable outside coverage may be authorised as goodwill only by a person holding the tier of authority set out in the Goodwill and Authority Matrix for that amount, and only where the authority is recorded in the claim system. The Goodwill and Authority Matrix referred to at clause 7.1 is published alongside this policy.\u0022,\u0022RelevanceScore\u0022:0.8323538},{\u0022Text\u0022:\u0022  \\r\\n**\\u003Cspan style=\\u0022color:#606060\\u0022\\u003ECONTOSO INDUSTRIAL\\u003C/span\\u003E**\\r\\n# Contoso Industrial Global Warranty Policy  \\r\\n_Version 4.2 \\u2014 effective 2025-04-01_\\r\\n\\u003Ctable\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctr\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Cth\\u003E  \\r\\n**Reference**\\r\\n\\u003C/th\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Cth\\u003E  \\r\\nPOL-WAR-4.2\\r\\n\\u003C/th\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003C/tr\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctr\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctd\\u003E  \\r\\n**Version**\\r\\n\\u003C/td\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctd\\u003E  \\r\\n4.2\\r\\n\\u003C/td\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003C/tr\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctr\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctd\\u003E  \\r\\n**Effective from**\\r\\n\\u003C/td\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctd\\u003E  \\r\\n2025-04-01\\r\\n\\u003C/td\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003C/tr\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctr\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctd\\u003E  \\r\\n**Document owner**\\r\\n\\u003C/td\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctd\\u003E  \\r\\nWarranty Operations\\r\\n\\u003C/td\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003C/tr\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctr\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctd\\u003E  \\r\\n**Applies to**\\r\\n\\u003C/td\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctd\\u003E  \\r\\nAll products, all regions, all authorised service partners\\r\\n\\u003C/td\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003C/tr\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctr\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctd\\u003E  \\r\\n**Supersedes**\\r\\n\\u003C/td\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003Ctd\\u003E  \\r\\nPOL-WAR-4.1 (effective 1 April 2024)\\r\\n\\u003C/td\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003C/tr\\u003E\\r\\n\\u003C/table\\u003E\\r\\n\\r\\n\\r\\n## Purpose\\r\\n  \\r\\nThis policy sets out the warranty Contoso Industrial provides on equipment it manufactures, the basis on which a claim from an authorised service partner is adjudicated, and the amounts payable. It applies to every claim submitted through the service claim system.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 1. Interpretation\\r\\n\\r\\n### 1.4  Precedence between instruments\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere two or more instruments address the same asset, the order of precedence is: (a) a Technical Service Bulletin that names the serial range of the asset; (b) the Regional Addendum for the region in which the asset is installed; (c) this policy. A Bulletin that has been superseded has no effect, whether or not it remains published. Where the Bulletin document and the service system applicability index disagree, the Bulletin document governs; the index is maintained for reporting and is informational only.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 2. Coverage\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.1  Standard coverage period\\r\\n  \\r\\nUnless extended or varied by an instrument of higher precedence, an asset is covered for twenty-four (24) months from the date of commissioning, or six thousand (6,000) running hours, whichever occurs first.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 2.3  Assets with no commissioning record\\r\\n  \\r\\nWhere the commissioning record for an asset is absent from the asset registry, coverage cannot be determined. The claim is to be held and the commissioning certificate requested from the installing partner. The date of despatch or the date of installation must not be substituted for the date of commissioning.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 4. Amounts payable\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.1  Labour\\r\\n  \\r\\nLabour is payable at the flat-rate allowance published for the operation code in the current Flat Rate Labour schedule, or at the hours actually claimed, whichever is the lesser. The rate applied is the regional labour rate in force on the date of repair.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.2  Parts\\r\\n  \\r\\nParts are payable at the published list price for the region, for the part actually fitted. Where a part has been superseded, the price of the superseding part applies.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 4.3  Handling\\r\\n  \\r\\nA handling uplift on parts is payable only where the partner\\u0027s Service Partner Agreement expressly grants one, at the percentage stated in that agreement.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 5. Exclusions\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.1  Exclusion - misuse and overload\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from operation outside the published duty envelope, including sustained overload, is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.2  Exclusion - fluid contamination\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from hydraulic fluid contamination above ISO 4406 class 18/16/13 is excluded, save where a Technical Service Bulletin provides otherwise.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.3  Exclusion - unauthorised modification\\r\\n  \\r\\nDamage arising from modification not authorised in writing by Contoso Industrial is excluded.\\r\\n\\r\\n### 5.4  Exclusion - consumables\\r\\n  \\r\\nFilters, fluids, belts, seals and other consumables are excluded when replaced as scheduled maintenance. Scheduled maintenance is not claimable under warranty and has no warranty operation code, so a consumable claimed under a warranty repair operation code is treated as a corrective repair and is covered, unless an inspection report records the replacement as routine.\\r\\n\\r\\n## 6. Repair warranty\\r\\n\\r\\n### 6.1  Repair warranty\\r\\n  \\r\\nA component replaced under warranty carries a further ninety (90) days of coverage from the date the repair was completed. UserQuery: I need a decision on C-2026-04185 before the partner call. What have we got?

Response.Content:
## Decision: **Approve C-2026-04185 — INR 199,175**

A **draft approval** has been recorded in the claim system as **ADJ-BBD5F0E1B5**, pending human review. **No payment has been made.**

### Payable
| Element | Calculation | Payable |
|---|---:|---:|
| Part P-44120-A | India list price | INR 191,200 |
| Labour | 5.5 hours × INR 1,450/hour | INR 7,975 |
| Handling uplift | 0% under Fabrikam’s SPA | INR 0 |
| **Total** |  | **INR 199,175** |

The claimed 5.5 hours exactly matches the HYD-PUMP-RR flat-rate allowance, and the applicable India rate on the 1 June 2026 repair date is INR 1,450/hour. P-44120-A is the current part actually fitted and is priced at INR 191,200; Fabrikam’s agreement provides no parts-handling uplift.

### Why it is covered
- **TSB-C-0051 applies.** Serial **CIE-4000-CH-01360** is inside the bulletin’s inclusive range **01200–01850**. The bulletin extends hydraulic-circuit and compressor coverage to **36 months or 8,000 hours**, whichever occurs first.
- At repair, the unit was **12 months from commissioning** and at **3,000 hours**, so it was comfortably inside both limits.
- Under policy clause 1.4, that serial-specific bulletin takes precedence over India’s normal **18-month/5,000-hour** terms.
- The fluid reading was above the usual contamination limit, but the inspection attributed the contamination to aluminium ingress from the **cracked filter housing**. **TSB-C-0043** therefore disapplies the fluid-contamination exclusion for this repair.
- The claim was submitted six days after repair, within Fabrikam’s 30-day submission requirement.

### Coding
- **Decision:** Approve
- **Funding code:** TSB
- **Instrument references:** **TSB-C-0051** and **TSB-C-0043**
- **Evidence request:** None required
- **Goodwill:** None

### Line for the partner call
> “We’re approving the claim at **INR 199,175**. The serial qualifies for the hydraulic coverage extension under TSB-C-0051, and TSB-C-0043 preserves coverage because the inspection links the contamination to the recognised filter-housing defect. That comprises INR 191,200 for the pump and INR 7,975 labour, with no handling uplift.”
